ps23-1.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.

php4-13.text: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.

ps46-1.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

rom12-12.text: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

php4-4.text: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice.

ps100-5.text: For the LORD is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

jhn14-27.text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid.

1th5-18.text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.

1co13-13.text: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.

ps23-2.text: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

rom12-21.text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

php4-6.text: Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.

ps100-2.text: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

jhn14-18.text: I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you.

ps23-3.text: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

rom12-15.text: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

php4-7.text: And the peace of God, which passeth all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus.

1th5-24.text: Faithful is he that calleth you, who also will do it.

ps100-4.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

rom12-18.text: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

jhn14-15.text: If ye love me, keep my commandments.

1co13-4.text: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,

ps46-10.text: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

php4-19.text: But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus.

1th5-11.text: Wherefore comfort yourselves together, and edify one another, even as also ye do.

ps100-1.text: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.

rom12-9.text: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

ps23-4.text: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

1th5-21.text: Prove all things; hold fast that which is good.

jhn3-16.text: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.

rom12-10.text: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

ps100-3.text: Know ye that the LORD he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

luk2-10.text: And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people.

luk2-11.text: For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

luk2-14.text: Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men.

isa9-2.text: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.

isa9-6.text: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
